title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill Blue Pear 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Dive into the intriguing world of Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fill's Blue Pear, an e-liquid that pairs two unlikely companions: ripe pear and blue raspberry. As you inhale, the first thing you'll notice is the delectable sweetness of ripe pear. This isn't just any pear; it's a perfectly matured fruit that's bursting with juicy sweetness. The pear sets the stage, offering a layered, fruit-forward profile that's incredibly satisfying. Just as you're settling into the familiar comfort of the pear, a wave of blue raspberry rolls in. It's a bit tart, adding a new dimension that complements the initial sweetness. It's this contrast between the pear's sweetness and the blue raspberry's tartness that truly makes this e-liquid stand out. You'll find yourself taken aback by how well these two contrasting flavors meld into a singular, unique experience. Blue Pear is for the adventurous, those looking for a break from the usual fruit-flavoured vapes. It's a new twist that turns the familiar into something extraordinary. Each puff feels like a journey—a ride along a path you've never taken but instantly adore. Discover unparalleled vaping bliss with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fills. Boasting ten mouth-watering, double-concentrated flavours, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to tantalise your taste buds while keeping nicotine cravings at bay. Unique in their 50/50 VG/PG blend, Pod Fills are versatile, ideal for Starter Kits , MTL Pod Kits , and devices with coils of 0.8ohm or higher. Enjoy the convenience of a 100ml shortfill bottle, complete with 20ml of extra space for your preferred nicotine shot. For instance, add 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots to create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid.
